pest_break.note: Fix of spec B4.7 (see README): 100 x min(1, distinct families/3) x min(1, extra host-free years / 3). Host = today's main crop (Alfalfa hay, 2 cuts, irrigated (Shuswap)); extra host-free years = (longest circular stretch without the host - today's) / 365, so today's rotation scores 0 and the normal winter gap earns nothing. 3 years for a full break from UC IPM alfalfa ('a 3- to 4-year nonhost crop rotation is ideal'); range 2-4 years; using it for rice is our assumption (U); UC IPM rice (https://ipm.ucanr.edu/agriculture/rice/integrated-weed-management/) names cereals, safflower and dry fallow as rotations out of rice. Families ['Fabaceae', 'Poaceae']; Alfalfa hay, 2 cuts, irrigated (Shuswap) never grown in the modelled cycle (counted as a full break; the real break depends on the years around it). No pest dataset exists. rule of thumb, not a model
